coordinates: Sheet inches from the page's top-left (x right, y down). Region polygons, seams, guides and landmarks are panel inches: from the panel's top-left. A front or back image given on its own covers exactly its panel; a sheet image covers the whole page.

views.front: as you face the performer: the performer's right is on your left
views.back: as you stand behind the performer: the performer's left is on your left

regionNotes: Each garment polygon is its left side seam top to bottom, then its right side seam bottom to top; the torso's then runs along its top edge (round the neck and over the shoulders) back to the start. seams.rows are [y, left x, right x] every 0.25 in. Both edges of every region are side seams, where the front flat meets the back flat. The head, neck, hands, shoes and hat are outside every region: they take palette colors only.

guides.label: neckline at the centre front (above it: the neck, palette colors only)
